board.name: Authentic
board.content:
We’re a tech-enabled MGA (managing general agent) that designs and runs insurance programs for specific kinds of businesses, like restaurants, gyms, and power producers. Brokers bring us the businesses that need coverage, and carriers back our policies.

 

Across the industry, new programs still get built mostly from scratch. We built our own platform so we don’t have to, and we own every line of code behind it. Engineers and insurance experts build it side by side in New York and Dayton, Ohio.

 

Find your role below.

 

Scammers sometimes pose as real companies, including ours, to steal money or personal information. We never interview by text or instant message, and every offer comes after in-person interviews. No one at Authentic will ask you to buy equipment or share your bank details or Social Security number. If a message claiming to be from us does any of this, don’t respond, and report it as spam.
